title: Bali and Singapore Family Holiday
alt: Sentosa island cable car above the water in Singapore
transport: Private transfers, city tours and guided day tours

stops.name: Kuta
stops.subtitle: Kuta to Kintamani and Tanjung Benoa
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Surf style hotel five minutes from Kuta beach

activities.name: Kintamani with the jungle swing
activities.description: Coffee plantation tasting on the climb to Kintamani, the crater lake view, Tegenungan waterfall, the Tegalalang terraces and the jungle swing.

activities.name: Water sports with the pirate dinner cruise
activities.match: Water Sports in Bali with Pirate Dinner Cruise
activities.description: Banana boat, jet ski and parasailing at Tanjung Benoa by day, then the pirate ship cruise in the evening with dinner and a deck show.

program.name: Kuta
program.description: Three nights in Bali to open the holiday, with a coffee plantation day up to Kintamani and a pirate ship dinner cruise the children will remember.

stops.name: Singapore
stops.subtitle: Singapore to Sentosa
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Novena hotel one stop from Orchard Road on the metro

activities.name: Singapore city tour
activities.description: A half day tour past Merlion Park, the Marina Bay waterfront, Chinatown and the colonial quarter, with a guide on a shared coach.

activities.name: Sentosa cable car sky pass
activities.description: Two cable car lines over the harbour and across Sentosa, the easiest way to see the island and the port from above.

activities.name: Adventure Cove Waterpark
activities.description: Six water slides, a lazy river and a reef you can snorkel, the best Sentosa attraction for families with younger children.

activities.name: Wings of Time show
activities.description: An evening show on Siloso beach with water jets, lasers and fire, staged over the sea at the end of your Sentosa day.

program.name: Singapore
program.description: Three nights in the city with a guided city tour and a full Sentosa day of cable cars, the water park and the Wings of Time show.

1: Arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport and private transfer to your hotel
Check in at your Kuta hotel near the beach
Rest of the day free on the south coast
Optional: Kuta beach, the art market or Waterbom park
2: Breakfast, then a full day out with your own car and guide
Coffee plantation tasting on the climb to Kintamani
Tegenungan waterfall and the Tegalalang rice terraces
A turn on the jungle swing above the valley
3: Breakfast, then a morning at Tanjung Benoa beach
Banana boat, jet ski and parasailing with an instructor
Evening pirate ship cruise with dinner and a deck show
Back at the hotel late in the evening
4: Breakfast and check out, then private transfer to the airport
Optional: flight from Denpasar to Singapore, which we can add
Arrival at Changi and private transfer to your hotel
Rest of the day free around Novena and Orchard Road
5: Breakfast, then a half day city tour with a guide
Merlion Park, Marina Bay and the colonial quarter
Chinatown lanes and the Sri Mariamman temple
Optional: the Supertree light show at Gardens by the Bay
6: Breakfast, then across to Sentosa island
Cable car sky pass over the harbour and the island
Adventure Cove Waterpark for the rest of the day
Wings of Time show on Siloso beach in the evening
7: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Changi Airport for your flight home

expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: Bali for the sea and the swing, Singapore for Sentosa. Two countries, six nights, and children who never get bored.
expert.tip: Keep the Sentosa day for last, children sleep on the flight home afterwards. Book Adventure Cove for the morning when the slides are quiet and carry a change of clothes for the Wings of Time show.

summary: Seven days across two countries for families: three nights in Bali with Kintamani, the jungle swing, water sports and a pirate ship dinner cruise, then three in Singapore with a city tour and a full Sentosa day.
included: Included: 6 nights with daily breakfast; private airport and city transfers; Kintamani and jungle swing tour; water sports with the pirate dinner cruise; Singapore city tour; Sentosa cable car sky pass; Adventure Cove Waterpark; Wings of Time show.
not_included: Not included: international flights; the Denpasar to Singapore flight, which we can add; visa fees; lunches and other dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
